about.title: About RideNow — A more considered way to move
about.description: The RideNow story, mission, and direction for Rider and Driver journeys in Sri Lanka.
heading: Movement,
made more human.
about.lede: RideNow is being built around a simple thought: the journey should feel considered, from the first tap to the moment you arrive.
about.imageAlt: Colombo's waterfront and city lights reflected on an evening road

sections.title: A product in progress, shaped around everyday journeys.
sections.text: RideNow is an original Sri Lankan ride-hailing project in development. The work today is about building a thoughtful foundation for Riders and Drivers: a clear experience, familiar payments, and useful tools for real journeys. There is no operational ride service to book yet.
sections.imageAlt: A Sri Lankan coastal city seen from a car at golden hour

sections.title: Make getting there feel simpler.

items.title: For the journey
items.text: Design around the real steps of a ride, with clear information at each point.

items.title: For Sri Lanka
items.text: Build for local context, Sinhala, Tamil and English, and prices expressed in LKR.

items.title: For both sides
items.text: Give Riders and Drivers an experience that respects their time and choices.

sections.title: A more connected way to move through the places we call home.
sections.text: That vision will be measured by what the product can reliably deliver—not by promises made before launch.

sections.title: What would you like to know?

items.q: Can I book a RideNow ride today?
items.a: Not yet. The Rider app and service are in development. This website does not accept ride requests.

items.q: Can I create a Rider or Driver account?
items.a: No. Account registration and authentication are not connected to this website.

items.q: Is there a RideNow app listing?
items.a: There are no public app-store listings today. The Rider and Driver apps are development previews.
Fare rates have not been set or published. Any future fare and applicable charges should be shown before a Rider confirms a trip.
RideNow is being designed cash-first, with amounts in Sri Lankan rupees (LKR). Electronic payment options have not been announced.
RideNow's stated model is zero commission on Driver fares. Other fees, settlement rules, and final Driver terms still need to be confirmed.
Operational service areas have not been announced. The Colombo imagery on this site is illustrative, not an availability map.

items.q: Why might the apps ask for location?
items.a: The planned apps may use location to set a pickup point and support availability or an active trip. This website does not request location.

items.q: How can I contact support about an account or trip?
items.a: There are no live accounts or trips, and a monitored support channel has not been published. Do not send sensitive personal information through this preview.

contact.title: Contact RideNow — Get in touch

sections.title: Send a message
sections.text: This form demonstrates the fields and validation RideNow may use. It does not send, store, or deliver messages; no production contact system is connected.

sections.title: The RideNow operating entity and public support contacts have not yet been confirmed.
sections.text: We won’t publish a guessed email address or physical address. Please don’t enter sensitive account, identity, or payment information in this preview form.

sections.title: Move through the idea

steps.title: Set your pickup
steps.text: Use a pickup point that makes sense for where you are. Location entry and provider choices are still being implemented.

steps.title: Choose a destination
steps.text: Add where you want to go. Planned map, search, geocoding, and routing providers have not been selected.

steps.title: Review the trip
steps.text: See the route and fare information before deciding. Fare rules and rates are not yet defined.

steps.title: Request and pay
steps.text: A future request can be matched with an available Driver. The product is designed cash-first in LKR; no live dispatch or payment is connected.

fares.title: RideNow fares — How pricing is being designed
fares.description: Understand RideNow's planned cash-first, LKR fare approach. No live rates or fare estimates are published.
heading: A fare should
make sense.
fares.lede: RideNow is being designed around clear fare information in Sri Lankan rupees. Actual prices and rules are not available yet.
fares.imageAlt: Colombo's waterfront and city lights reflected on an evening road

sections.title: What we believe a Rider should be able to see.

items.title: A price in LKR
items.text: Display trip prices in Sri Lankan rupees, with the currency identified clearly.

items.title: Details before confirmation
items.text: Show the fare and any applicable charges before the Rider confirms a trip.

items.title: A familiar way to pay
items.text: Cash-first is the current design direction. No electronic payment option has been announced.

sections.title: No fare calculator or price list is available yet.
sections.text: Vehicle categories, minimum fares, distance or time rates, waiting charges, cancellations, taxes, tolls, and settlement rules all require business decisions. Don’t use this page to estimate a real trip.

sections.title: Zero commission on Driver fares is RideNow’s stated direction.
sections.text: The exact settlement process, any other fees, taxes, and Driver agreement terms must be defined and shown before onboarding. No final fare or payout schedule is being represented here.
sections.imageAlt: A car on Colombo's waterfront road at sunrise

cities.title: RideNow cities — Service coverage is not announced
cities.description: RideNow has not announced operating cities or service availability. Check this page for confirmed coverage in future.
cities.eyebrow: Local by design, not yet live
heading: A city is more

cities.lede: RideNow is being developed for Sri Lankan journeys. No city or service area is currently open for bookings.
cities.imageAlt: An illustrative view of Colombo's waterfront at blue hour, not a service map

sections.title: Service locations have not been announced.
sections.text: The Colombo scenes across this website are original concept artwork. They do not show live Drivers, operating boundaries, or current availability. City selection, launch timing, and coverage will be published only after RideNow confirms them.

safety.title: RideNow safety — Principles for a safer ride experience
safety.description: Read about safety principles being considered for RideNow Riders and Drivers. No live safety response service is available.
heading: Safety starts
before the ride.
safety.lede: The product is still in development. These are design priorities, not a claim that safety features or live response services are active.
safety.imageAlt: A car at Colombo's waterfront in early light

sections.title: The basics need to be clear and dependable.

items.title: Know who you’re travelling with
items.text: Trip screens should clearly show relevant Rider, Driver, and vehicle details once a ride is accepted.

items.title: Location with purpose
items.text: Location permission should be explained in context and requested only for defined journey features.

items.title: A clear way to get help
items.text: RideNow must establish and publish support, complaint, and incident-response processes before service launch.

sections.title: Contact the appropriate local emergency service first.
sections.text: RideNow has not published an emergency response line or a live safety team. Do not rely on this website for urgent assistance.

sections.title: Safety tools require operational decisions, not just interface design.
sections.text: Identity and vehicle checks, trip sharing, incident handling, support coverage, data access, and escalation procedures need verified processes and responsible teams before they can be described as available.
sections.imageAlt: An illustrative car journey on the Sri Lankan coast

newsroom.title: RideNow Newsroom — Product notes and announcements
newsroom.description: The RideNow newsroom for verified product announcements and updates. No launch date or service area has been announced.

sections.title: What this RideNow preview is—and what it isn’t.
sections.text: RideNow is an original Sri Lankan ride-hailing project in development. The website shows Rider and Driver product direction; it does not provide live bookings, accounts, app-store listings, or operating coverage.

business.title: RideNow for business — Transportation ideas for teams
business.description: Explore the business transportation needs RideNow may support. No business product, account, or service is currently available.
business.eyebrow: For journeys that bring work together
heading: Business travel,
with room to move.
business.lede: We’re exploring what a considered ride experience could mean for teams in Sri Lanka. No corporate booking product is live.
business.imageAlt: A car on a city waterfront road at sunrise

sections.title: A useful service begins with the needs of real teams.
sections.text: Scheduled journeys, staff travel, account controls, consolidated billing, and service-level commitments are possibilities to research—not features RideNow currently offers. Any future business product would need defined eligibility, pricing, support, and privacy terms.
sections.imageAlt: A view of the road ahead from inside a car

sections.title: There is no business account or corporate ride service yet.
sections.text: Organisations interested in future discussions can use the preview contact form. It does not deliver messages to RideNow today.

partners.title: Partner with RideNow — Collaboration, considered carefully
partners.description: Learn about the partnership areas RideNow expects to evaluate. No partner program or commercial agreements are available.
heading: Good partnerships
start with clarity.
partners.lede: RideNow will need dependable partners in the places where technology meets a real journey. Those relationships are not yet in operation.

sections.title: Capabilities a ride platform may need.

items.title: Mapping and mobility
items.text: Maps, geocoding, routing, and location services require provider selection and coverage review.

items.title: Communications
items.text: SMS, notifications, hosting, and customer support need clear ownership and data safeguards.

items.title: Payments and local services
items.text: Any payment or commercial partnership depends on the final operating model and regulatory review.

sections.title: Provider and partnership enquiries can start with a conversation.
sections.text: This website has no partner submission or onboarding service. The contact form is a local preview only; messages are not sent.

careers.title: Careers at RideNow — Opportunities as the team takes shape
careers.description: RideNow is building its team over time. No current job openings or recruitment process have been published.
heading: A thoughtful service
needs thoughtful people.
careers.lede: RideNow is in development. We’ll list real openings here when roles, hiring teams, and application channels are ready.
careers.imageAlt: A view through a car toward a city at night

sections.title: There are no active job listings today.
sections.text: No application process, salary information, or hiring contact has been published. Be cautious of anyone claiming to recruit on RideNow’s behalf or requesting payment for a job opportunity.

accessibility.title: RideNow accessibility — Designing for more people
accessibility.description: Learn about RideNow's accessibility approach for this website and the planned Rider and Driver apps.
heading: Access is part
of the journey.
accessibility.lede: RideNow is being designed to work for people with different devices, languages, abilities, and ways of moving. The apps are not yet live for an accessibility audit.
accessibility.imageAlt: A coastal city road seen from a vehicle

sections.title: Accessibility belongs in the everyday details.

items.title: Readable and adaptable
items.text: Use legible type, sufficient contrast, zoom-friendly layouts, and support for system text settings.

items.title: Keyboard and assistive technology
items.text: Use semantic controls, visible focus, clear names, and a logical reading order on the website.

items.title: Language and context
items.text: Plan for English, Sinhala, and Tamil, and explain permissions and trip decisions in plain language.

items.title: Real-world accessibility
items.text: Accessibility needs in vehicles, pickup points, service processes, and support require research and operational planning.

sections.title: A monitored accessibility contact is not yet available.
sections.text: The contact form is a visual and validation preview; it cannot deliver feedback. A public feedback route should be provided before launch.
